allow: PowerShell(python -m uv add --dev pytest pytest-asyncio ruff mypy 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 8)

PowerShell($ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; for \($i=1; $i -le 5; $i++\) { python -m uv sync 2>&1 | Out-Null; if \($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0\) { Write-Output "SYNC OK on attempt $i"; break } else { Write-Output "attempt $i failed, retrying" } })
PowerShell(python -m uv run ruff check core tests 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20; Write-Output "=== MYPY ==="; python -m uv run mypy core 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 20)
PowerShell(python -m uv run ruff check core tests 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5; Write-Output "=== PYTEST ==="; python -m uv run pytest -q 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 3)
